title: Script artifact bundle v4 (bounded text tree), feature 023 draft
description: Canonical JSON (keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace); digest = sha256 of the bytes; signed as every bundle (Ed25519 over sagat/script-artifact/v1 || tenant || digest || language). Only php and the reserved image-catalog runtime python-data (FR-023-027, owned by feature 024 for its content) may use v4. This schema states shape; crates/infra-schema/src/bundle.rs additionally enforces canonical encoding, path normalization, case-insensitive uniqueness, the decoded-content total and the 2 MiB stored ceiling, before signing and again at the runner's load. For python-data the runner also refuses the bundle unless runtimeCatalog equals its configured runtime image's catalog digest. Bundles v1, v2 and v3 are unchanged.

policy.description: Canonical policy text the build was clamped to; re-parsed with Policy::parse_canonical.

lockDigest.description: SHA-256 of the version's lockfile bytes (composer.lock for php, hash-pinned requirements for python-data); null when the version has no lockfile.

runtimeCatalog.description: php: null (packages travel in files). python-data: the catalog digest of the runtime image the artifact was built against; required.

additionalProperties.description: UTF-8 text without NUL. The sum of decoded lengths is at most 1,433,600 bytes (1,400 KiB).
